Kill 5/15/30 infected with bows or crossbows
Survive 10/20/30 hits from infected or animals
Kill 5/15/30 infected with semi-auto or bolt-action rifles
Reach a city on at least 1/2/3 island(s)
Place 1/2/3 Wooden Fences or Barbed Wires
Find the medieval castle, a testament to a glorious era
Enter the bunker, a military fortress that failed to stop the virus
Equip a full protective suit and gas mask
Kill every type of infected on Legendary difficulty
You can fight unarmed or with melee weapons Melee combat happens automatically when close to an enemy Each melee weapon has a chance to block or deal critical damage
For ranged weapons, aiming is automatic But firing is manual, accuracy is greatly reduced while running
Campfires provide heat, light, and a way to cook food Can be lit up to 3 times after placement
You can grow vegetables for food But they may wither due to weather effects
You can craft items using materials You can find and collect them

When injured, you may start bleeding While bleeding, your health won't regenerate and you'll lose blood continuously Use Bandages, Rags, or Surgical Tape to stop bleeding Bleeding can also stop naturally

Entering certain areas without protective gear, or being attacked by rare infected Can poison you, and if your temperature gets too low, you'll get sick When sick or poisoned, your health won't regenerate and your wellness will drop To cure sickness or poisoning, take Tetracycline Or stay healthy with Hunger, Thirst, and Temperature above 80%
Cold weather lowers your body temperature At night, during rain or snow, it gets colder After midnight, the night becomes completely dark
Keep your Hunger, Thirst, Wellness, and Temperature above 50% Otherwise, you will not regenerate health
If your health reaches 0, you die You have a chance to start bleeding when injured If your Hunger, Thirst, Wellness, or Temperature reaches 0 You will also start bleeding
Use Bandages or Rags to stop bleeding quickly Some clothing can be torn into rags
Use Blood Bags or Saline to restore health quickly
If your Hunger, Thirst, Wellness, and Temperature Are all above 50%, you will start regenerating health
You can warm up inside buildings
Wear warm clothes to stay warm
Drink Whiskey or Beer to increase temperature
Build a campfire to warm up
Find and set up a tent, you can also warm up inside it
Most supplies can be found in buildings
Supplies can also be found in car trunks
You can find berries in some bushes
Use a Hand Axe or Fire Axe to chop trees Different trees yield different amounts of wood Other useful resources can be found around the world
Find a Headlamp or Night Vision Goggles to see in the dark They require batteries to operate
Flares illuminate a small area when thrown
Campfires illuminate a small area for a long time
Water pumps contain drinking water You can get water directly from them But the water in a pump is limited per day
You can fill Water Bottles or Canteens at water pumps During rain, you can also place an empty bottle on the ground to collect water
Sewing Kit increases clothing durability by 50%
Cleaning Kit increases firearm durability by 25%
You can find Deer or Rabbits in the wild, they are cautious You need ranged weapons to take them down
Use a knife to skin dead deer or rabbits Get meat
Raw meat can be cooked over a fire
Improvised Backpack + Stick×3 = Reinforced Improvised Backpack
Place the Campfire Kit on the ground, light it with matches
The map will be available after the tutorial
Boats can be found on the east coast and repaired to reach the next island Note! Once you reach the next island You cannot return to the previous one
Place a Civilian Tent to store supplies and provide warmth Items in the tent will not despawn
Wooden Fence (Wood + Stick×5 = Wooden Fence) blocks enemies Barbed Wire damages and slows enemies
Marksman Level 1: Increases firearm critical chance by 10% Level 2: Increases firearm critical damage by 30%
Reconnaissance Level 1: You can spot other survivors from further away Level 2: You can identify distant survivors from afar
Sprinter Level 1: Increases movement speed by 5% Level 2: Increases movement speed by 10%
Thirst Resistance Level 1: Reduces thirst rate by 10% Level 2: All canned drinks provide +10 extra thirst
Hunger Resistance Level 1: Reduces hunger rate by 10% Level 2: All canned food provides +10 extra hunger
Cold Resistance Level 1: Reduces heat loss by 50% during rain or snow Level 2: Grants +2 extra warmth
Ammo Scrounger Level 1: All found firearms contain at least 1 bullet Level 2: All found ammunition stacks contain an extra 10 bullets
Will to Live Level 1: Increases health regen rate when below 50% health Level 2: Increases movement speed by 10% when below 20% health
Blocking Expertise Level 1: Increases melee weapon block chance by 5% Level 2: Increases melee weapon block chance by 10%
Lethal Strike Level 1: Increases melee weapon critical chance by 10% Level 2: Increases melee weapon critical damage by 30%
Scrounger Level 1: Increases chance to find supplies in car trunks by 20% Level 2: Increases chance to find 2 supplies in a trunk by 10%
Hunter Level 1: Reduces chance for animals to detect you Level 2: 50% chance to get extra meat when skinning
Cozy Home Level 1: Gain 50% more warmth inside buildings Level 2: Reduces hunger and thirst rate by 30% while sleeping
Vigor Level 1: Reduces bleeding rate by 50% Level 2: Doubles natural bleeding stop speed
Alertness Level 1: You can detect hidden enemies more clearly Level 2: Your vision is slightly clearer at night
Farmer Level 1: 50% chance to get an extra berry when collecting Level 2: 50% chance to get an extra vegetable when harvesting

Optical Scope - Reduces spread, increases critical chance

Rabbit A common wild rabbit, flees at high speed when approached Health: 5
Deer A common wild deer, stays alert to all creatures around it Health: 80
Albino Deer An extremely rare albino deer, its snow-white fur blends perfectly with the snow Health: 80
Wolf A dangerous creature of the wild, often moves in packs Health: 50
Bear The most dangerous creature in the wild, with a strong build and terrifying attack power Health: 500
Chicken Once a domestic animal, still found on farms today Health: 5 Favorite foods: Cranberries, Cloudberries, Raspberries, Elderberries, Earthworms
Pig Once a domestic animal, still found on farms today Health: 20 Favorite foods: Tomato, Apple, Banana, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Orange, Cranberry, Cloudberry, Raspberry, Elderberry
Dog The most reliable companion, can provide many forms of help Health: N/A
Infected Ordinary people who didn't survive the outbreak, now trying to tear apart every living thing they see Health: 60 / 120 (Radiation Zone)
Crawler Moves faster and is more dangerous than regular infected Health: 80 / 160 (Radiation Zone)
Lurker Unlike other infected, it doesn't actively seek targets, instead hiding to deliver a lethal blow to careless passersby Health: 60 / 120 (Radiation Zone)
Infected Soldier An infected soldier, with a stronger body than regular infected Health: 100 / 200 (Radiation Zone)
Yellow Protective Suit Infected A swollen infected, its protective suit filled with deadly corrosive fluid that spills out upon death Health: 80 / 160 (Radiation Zone)
Red Protective Suit Infected Prolonged contact with chemicals caused mutation, granting faster movement and stronger lingering poison Health: 120 / 240 (Radiation Zone)
Howler This weak infected can't harm you, but it will roar to attract nearby infected to swarm you Health: 50 / 100 (Radiation Zone)
Infected Police Officer The virus preserved its instinct to shoot, making it more dangerous than regular infected Health: 100 / 200 (Radiation Zone)
Infected Officer Was an officer before infection, giving it a stronger body and preserved shooting instinct Health: 120 / 240 (Radiation Zone)
Riot Infected This heavily armored individual from before is now one of the infected Health: 250 / 500 (Radiation Zone)
Leaper The virus greatly enhanced its leaping ability, allowing it to pounce on targets Health: 150 / 300 (Radiation Zone)
Spitter Its mouth contains large amounts of deadly liquid due to viral mutation, which it tries to spit at living things it sees Health: 100 / 200 (Radiation Zone)
Runner Once an excellent athlete, its former agility makes it try to dodge your ranged attacks Health: 100 / 200 (Radiation Zone)
Infected Drill Instructor The virus preserved its strength and agility, and it will try to dodge your ranged attacks Health: 120 / 240 (Radiation Zone)
Smoker This disgusting-looking infected has an extremely long tongue and will try to drag creatures towards it Health: 100 / 200 (Radiation Zone)
Armed Gorka Infected Well-equipped infected with preserved shooting instinct, will try to fire continuously at living things Health: 175 / 350 (Radiation Zone)
Heavily Armored Infected A well-equipped infected, the heavy armor worn in life now protects it well Health: N/A / 1000 (Radiation Zone)
Glowing One Prolonged radiation exposure caused a horrific mutation, making it more lethal and faster Health: N/A / 500 (Radiation Zone)
Infected Researcher A scientist trying to find a cure, injected with a failed vaccine after infection, undergoing a horrific mutation Health: N/A / 1000 (Radiation Zone)
Tank An extremely terrifying infected, the virus greatly enhanced its body and strength. Engaging it in melee is likely a foolish decision Health: 2000 / 4000 (Radiation Zone)
[From Winter Content Pack] Snowman This Howler has been dramatically wrapped in fairy lights by someone. Even zombies need to celebrate the holidays Health: 50 / 100 (Radiation Zone)
Survivor Neutral Survivor: Won't attack you, can trade with you Hostile Survivor: Attacks other survivors to loot supplies Friendly Survivor: Sticks with you, intends to survive together Health: 100
Black Ops Dangerous individuals in the apocalypse, well-equipped, attempt to attack all other survivors Health: 110
Gorka Black Ops A leader among Black Ops, better equipped and more dangerous Health: 250
Hazmat Black Ops Black Ops faction exploration team sent into radiation zones, equipped with better weapons to deal with stronger infected Health: 150
Altyn Black Ops The most dangerous Black Ops, with excellent armor and strong aggression Health: 500
Exit the game? Progress in this mode will not be saved
You can repair this boat with logs to go to the next island. Use an axe to chop down a tree and get logs.
There seem to be some supplies here. Get closer to pick them up.
You can check your items in the inventory.
This is your hotbar. It's usable even without equipment slots. Tap to select an item.
Welcome, survivor. You are stranded on a small island. Your only way to other islands is to find a boat or bridge on the east coast.
Tap or drag to move your character.
Use the virtual stick to move.
Choose your preferred movement method. You can change it anytime in settings.
As you kill enemies and play longer, you gain experience points. You can use XP to unlock new skills.
Select a skill to invest points and learn it. Each skill has two levels.
Press the interact button to pick up items or interact.
Now you have a ranged weapon. Equipping it automatically aims. Press the fire button to shoot.
When you have the appropriate ammo, press the reload button to reload.
Switch between melee and ranged weapons. Order: Melee -> Primary -> Secondary.
You are bleeding. Find a bandage or tear your T-shirt into rags to bandage.
Your health is empty. In the tutorial, you will be healed to full to continue.
You can drag items to organize your inventory.
That's a gun. Firearms can usually be found at military bases and gun stores.
There's an infected ahead. Your character will attack automatically when close.
That's a wolf. Often appears in packs, quite dangerous.
That's a water pump. You can drink directly from it or fill containers.
That's a wrecked car. You can search the trunk for supplies.
You can hunt deer and use a knife to get venison.
You can hunt rabbits and use a knife to get rabbit meat.
You can look around and pick berries from some bushes.
